risk_if_not_implemented: Without Host Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (HIDS / HIPS), malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), System / Service Compromise (R-EX-7), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Host Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (HIDS / HIPS) (END-12) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Malicious Code Protection (Antimalware)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize antimalware, or similar technologies, to detect and eradicate malicious code.
compensating_control_2.justification: Malicious Code Protection (Antimalware) (END-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Host Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (HIDS / HIPS) (END-12) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
